Incoming new zombie!|Beginning of Wave 5 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Golden Mode|Golden]] & [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Quick''' is the second [[Enemies|enemy]] the player faces in the game in [[Molten Mode|Molten]], [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]], [[Challenge Trials]], and all [[PVP]] arena modes. While it does appear in all [[PVP Test]] ranks, it can only be sent in Fallen Arena [[PVP]]. It also appears in [[Badlands II]] and [[Pizza Party]] maps, in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] and [[Golden Mode|Golden]] modes, and in [[The Takeover Event]]. It is faster than the [[Abnormal]] while also being tankier. The '''Quick''' can be spawned by the [[Dark Necromancer]]. Upon its death, the [[Mystery]] can spawn the '''Quick''' in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]]. == Logbook Description == "''The Quick zombie is a further mutation from the Abnormal. It is stronger and faster, leading it to sprint towards humans and other creatures. They are more aggressive than Normal and Abnormal zombies.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Quick''' has a desaturated blue skin color and a dirty dark brown torso and legs. It has dark blue veins on its arms and head. |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The legacy '''Quick''' has a reflective light blue skin color and a dark blue blue granite torso and legs. It has blue diamond-plated armbands and sharp glowing light blue crystals on its shoulders. It has two diagonal lines, forming a mirrored "y" on its face. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The current [[Enemies Beta]] version of the legacy '''Quick''' has a desaturated light blue skin color with navy veins being visible on its head and arms. It has a desaturated cyan torso and legs. |Version 2 |The second version of the legacy '''Quick''' was similar to the current version, except it had a sad face. |Version 1 |The first version of the legacy '''Quick''' had a baby blue skin color and a blue granite torso and legs. It also had a drooling zombie face. }} }} ==Strategy== *Most towers can deal with the '''Quick''' effectively. **Any tower catered towards early game, like the [[Cowboy]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Brawler]], [[Militant]] or [[Golden Cowboy]] is recommended **Towers with a slow firerate, like the [[Sniper]] or [[Shotgunner]], may struggle against hordes of '''Quicks'''. **Towers that can deal damage to multiple enemies are especially effective against '''Quicks''' as they spawn in hordes. Such towers include the [[Assassin]], [[Electroshocker]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Shotgunner]]. *While not recommended if you are not trying to activate the [[Hidden Wave]], it is an option to avoid defending against the first few waves of '''Quicks''' and simply let them reach the exit, as their low health makes it unlikely to make you lose. **You can use the [[Medic]] to heal the base health back, but it may not be necessary. **As you are not spending money on defenses, you can use the [[Farm]] more effectively for the first few waves to get better towers when stronger enemies appear. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants (Legacy)}} Quick2.png|Third version, first animation (8 May 2021 – 4 December 2021) Quick0.png|Second version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) Quick.png|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) {{GalleryHeader|Animations (Modern)}} QuickStun.gif|Current version, current stun animation (2 August 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Quick.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker2Quick.png|Overclock variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Modern)}} CorpseQuick.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, original animation variant (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants (Legacy)}} CorpseLegacyQuick.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} HalloweenPI2.jpg|'''Quick''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Entity System - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Quick''' on a promotional video.
